outcome: Inter- and intra-rater reliability of LUS thickness measurements
Agreement between ultrasound and MRI measurements
Anatomy and morphology of the CS-scar region
cohort: 25 asymptomatic patients with one previous CS and inconspicuous ultrasound findings
finding: MRI is appropriate for additional LUS diagnostics in patients with previous CS, but the strong individual variability of LUS anatomy and morphology might explain the difficulties in establishing uniform diagnostic standards after CS.
